title: Evaluation of a gate on functions
statement: Let $m,n$ be natural numbers, let a logical AND or OR gate be given, and let $m$ Boolean functions on the $n$-dimensional sign cube take values in $\\{ -1,1 \\}$. For any subset of the $m$ input indices, evaluating the gate pointwise at a cube point $x$ gives the same result as applying the gate to the values of those functions at $x$.
hypotheses_covered: A logical AND or OR gate
A function assigning a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube to each of the $m$ indices
A finite subset of input indices
A point of the sign cube
